# oVirt Console: webadmin Parity Gap Report

> **Refreshed 2026-11-11.** Every row and bullet of the original audit
> (2026-07-06) was re-checked against the code in `app/src` (pages, components,
> `api/resources`, `routes/router.tsx`, the mock handlers). Most of what the
> original report listed as missing has shipped; this version leads with what
> is still open. Statuses describe the `main` branch. Where a claim could not
> be confirmed from the code it is marked "unverified". README.md (Status) stays
> the high-level summary; this report is the itemized gap list behind it.

How to read the statuses:

- **Shipped**: a user-facing surface exists and is wired to a REST call.
  Verified by reading the code, not by exercising a live engine.
- **Partial**: present, with the missing piece named.
- **Open**: not in `main`.
- **Not implementable**: oVirt 4.5 REST has no surface for it; the reason is
  the one recorded in the code.
- **Deferred**: left out on purpose.

Effort sizes: **S** = a modal or field plus one resource function; **M** = a
multi-field dialog or a new subtab with actions; **L** = a new pipeline, wizard
or cross-cutting framework.

## 1. Executive summary

The console now has both read parity and broad write parity with webadmin
across Compute, Network, Storage and Administration. The five headline gaps of
the original audit are all closed: VM import (export domain and VMware / KVM /
Xen), the storage-domain lifecycle, governance CRUD (users, groups, roles,
system permissions, scheduling policies, quotas, providers), the full cluster
dialog, and affinity plus host runtime actions. Of the 52 "missing" rows in the
original section 3, 46 are shipped, 3 are partial and 3 are open (counting
method in section 7).

What remains is a short list:

1. **Per-VM tuning depth**: CPU pinning and virtual NUMA node editing, and the
   TPM device. All three are in progress on feature branches.
2. **Host network attachment custom properties** in Setup Host Networks (in
   progress).
3. **Navigation polish from `PLAN.md`**: right-click menus on the flat
   Templates and Hosts list rows, and `folder:` / `tag:` filter tokens (in
   progress).
4. **Roaming user settings**: preferences are still localStorage-only; the
   engine `/users/{id}/options` path is not wired.
5. **Extension points**: Cockpit SSO or embedding and a UI plugin model
   (skywalkw3r/ovirt-web-ui-ng#13). A plain Cockpit link tab exists today.
6. **Guided flows**: Guide Me and the aggregate Configure dialog.
7. **Dialog depth** on Templates, Pools and Instance Types, plus a handful of
   small per-dialog deferrals (section 3).

Import VM from OVA is not on the open list: the REST API has no OVA import
surface, so it is filed under "not implementable" (section 4). DWH-backed
analytics remain deliberately deferred (section 5).

### 2.3 Recommended next

In order of parity impact, all of these are open today:

1. **Land the four in-flight branches**: VM CPU pinning and vNUMA, host
   network attachment custom properties, flat-list context menus with
   `folder:` / `tag:` tokens, and VM TPM. They close the last per-VM and
   per-host tuning gaps and the two navigation leftovers from `PLAN.md`.
2. **Roaming user settings** through `/users/{id}/options`, with localStorage
   kept as the fallback (the pattern server-side bookmarks already use in
   `components/list-toolbar/BookmarkMenu.tsx`).
3. **Cockpit host console** as the first consumer of the extension work in
   issue #13: SSO where the engine supports it, a documented fallback where it
   does not, and an entry in the host kebab.
4. **Dialog depth for Templates, Pools and Instance Types**, reusing the Edit
   VM sections (`components/edit-vm`) so the three dialogs gain resource
   allocation, console and custom properties together.
5. **Guide Me for data center and cluster** (the M-sized slice), which also
   gives the aggregate Configure question a natural home.

## 3. Partial: what is present and what is missing

- **VM import**: the wizard (`components/vm-import/ImportVmWizard.tsx`) covers
  export domains and external VMware / KVM / Xen sources through
  `/externalvmimports`. OVA is not offered (section 4).
- **Setup Host Networks**: bonds (create, edit, break), IPv4 and IPv6, DNS
  resolver, per-attachment QoS, NIC labels, SR-IOV, LLDP, per-row sync and
  Sync All are present. Missing: attachment custom properties (section 2.1).
  The comment at `setupNetworksDraft.ts:522` that calls bond editing a deferred
  follow-up is stale; `modified_bonds` and `removed_bonds` are sent
  (`api/resources/hosts.ts`).
- **Edit VM**: sections present are General, System, Initial Run, Icon,
  Console, Host, High Availability, Resource Allocation, Boot Options, RNG and
  Custom Properties, plus the Next Run dialog and watchdog. Missing: CPU
  pinning, vNUMA editing, TPM, Foreman / Satellite (section 2).
- **Cockpit**: link tab only (section 2.2).
- **Bookmarks**: server-side through `/bookmarks`
  (`api/resources/bookmarks.ts`), with a localStorage fallback when the engine
  answers 403 or 404. Folder capture in a saved bookmark is still open per
  `PLAN.md` (unverified in code).
- **Tasks**: job steps expand per row, a correlation-id column and text filter
  exist, and "Clear finished" is a session-scoped client-side hide because the
  engine has no per-job hide call (`pages/TasksPage.tsx`). There is no
  own-session filter.
- **Dashboard**: capacity tiles, inventory rows with status deep links, a
  Gluster volumes row, a last-updated stamp and a refresh control are present.
  CPU and memory over-commit is an estimate summed from running VMs, and the
  sparklines are session-local, because the exact figures and history live in
  the DWH (section 5).
- **Gluster**: volume create, start, stop, rebalance, remove, brick add /
  remove / migrate, options and profiling start / stop ship in
  `components/volume-form` and `api/resources/volumes.ts`. Not built: a volume
  detail page, snapshots, geo-replication, the cluster Gluster Hooks and
  Services subtabs, host brick subtabs, and a view of gathered profile data.
- **Help menu**: About, keyboard shortcuts and a Documentation link
  (`components/AboutModal.tsx`). No Guide Me entry point.

## 4. Not implementable over REST 4.5

Each entry gives the reason recorded in the code.

- **Import VM from OVA.** `ExternalVmProviderType` is exactly KVM, XEN and
  VMWARE, and the api-model has no OVA import action; webadmin's OVA path
  rides internal GWT queries (`api/resources/externalVmImports.ts`,
  `components/vm-import/ImportVmWizard.tsx`). OVA export is available.
- **CPU type security warnings** (`secure-cpus-*-warning.png`). webadmin
  compares `cpu_verb` with the configured verb, a host's missing CPU flags and
  a VM's runtime CPU name. The backend computes these only for webadmin's own
  search, and REST serializes none of them: clusters and hosts expose only
  `cpu.type`, `/clusterlevels/{v}/cputypes` carries no flags, and VMs expose
  only `custom_cpu_model`.
- **Per-device memory Hot Unplug** (`memory-hot-unplug-webadmin.png`). REST
  only supports lowering a running VM's memory, with the engine choosing the
  devices; Edit VM already does that.
- **Active User Sessions main tab and terminate.** Listed in README.md as
  having no REST surface; no code in `app/src` attempts it. VM-level sessions
  are available (`components/vm-tabs/SessionsTab.tsx`).
- **Hosted-engine global HA maintenance toggle.** The host schema reads
  `global_maintenance` (`api/schemas/host.ts`) but README.md records that REST
  offers no action to set it.
- **SMTP / SNMP notifier transport settings.** These are
  `ovirt-engine-notifier` file configuration with no REST surface
  (`api/resources/users.ts`). Per-user event subscriptions are managed.
- **Cluster dialog: "Change existing VMs/Templates from I440FX to Q35".** A
  webadmin-internal mass update with no REST field
  (`components/cluster-form/clusterDraft.ts`).
- **User detail Quota tab as webadmin computes it.** A quota-scoped permission
  serializes without its object link, so the join runs quota-side instead
  (`api/resources/users.ts`). The tab exists; this is a documented divergence,
  not a gap.
- **Server-side "Clear finished tasks".** No per-job hide call; done as a
  client-side hide (section 3).
- **Several list-grid columns**: Disks Creation Date / Last Modified, Storage
  Confirmed Free Space, Volumes Activities and Number of Snapshots are GWT-only
  fields the REST mappers never emit (comments in the respective list pages).

Catalogs that webadmin compiles statically and REST does not list (migration
policies, the notifiable-event catalog, the permit catalog fallback) are
shipped as source-verified static lists, as `CONTRIBUTING.md` prescribes.

## 5. Deliberately deferred

- **DWH-backed analytics**: historical utilization trends, per-object heatmaps
  with drill-down, the exact committed / allocated figures the webadmin
  dashboard reads from the Data Warehouse, and the `webadmin/dashboard_data`
  servlet. Approximated live from REST; the Monitoring Portal (Grafana) link is
  the stand-in.
- **Gluster beyond volume lifecycle**: see the Gluster bullet in section 3.
- **Storage DR (active-active geo)**: GWT-internal, no clean REST parity.
- **Foreman / Satellite provisioning**: host discovery and the New Host
  Network Provider tab (`components/host-form/NewHostModal.tsx`), and the Edit
  VM section listed in section 2.2.
- **Running existing GWT UI plugins unchanged**: a stated non-goal of issue
  #13.

## 6. Shipped since the original audit

A compact record, grouped as the original report grouped its gaps. Paths are
under `app/src`.

**Storage**

- Domain lifecycle: attach, detach, activate, maintenance, edit, remove,
  destroy, import, LUN extend and reduce (`components/storage-domain-form`,
  `components/datacenter-form/DataCenterStorageActionsTab.tsx`).
- New Domain types: NFS, iSCSI, FC, POSIX, GlusterFS, Local on Host, Managed
  Block Storage (`NewStorageDomainModal.tsx`).
- Storage-domain subtabs: Data Centers, Disk Profiles (CRUD), Disk Snapshots,
  Images, Leases, Register VMs, Register Templates, Disk Import
  (`components/storage-domain-tabs`).
- Disks page: New (image and direct LUN), Edit, Remove, Move, Copy, Sparsify,
  Upload and Download through imageio (`pages/DisksPage.tsx`,
  `components/disk-form`). A standalone managed-block disk on the Disks page is
  unverified.
- Storage QoS authoring as one of the four data-center QoS types.
- iSCSI Multipathing subtab (`components/datacenter-tabs/IscsiMultipathTab.tsx`).

**Compute: VMs, templates, pools, affinity**

- VM import from export domains and VMware / KVM / Xen; export to OVA and to an
  export domain (`components/vm-export/ExportVmModal.tsx`).
- Change CD, Run Once (boot order, CD, host, stateless, cloud-init / sysprep,
  kernel boot, custom properties).
- Edit VM sections listed in section 3, the Next Run dialog, cloud-init
  networks / DNS / custom script and the Windows sysprep path in the wizard,
  Edit VM and Run Once.
- Affinity groups and labels: create, edit, delete on the cluster tabs; attach
  and detach from the VM tabs (`components/affinity`,
  `components/vm-tabs/AffinityGroupsTab.tsx`, `AffinityLabelsTab.tsx`).
- Pool detail page with General, Virtual Machines and Permissions.
- VM subtabs: disk activate / move / copy / sparsify, host device attach and
  detach, Sessions. Template NIC add / edit / remove.

**Compute: data centers, clusters, hosts**

- Cluster New / Edit section set (General, Optimization, Migration, Fencing,
  Console, MAC Pool, with the scheduling policy) and rolling cluster upgrade (`components/cluster-form`,
  `components/cluster-upgrade`).
- Host: reinstall, refresh capabilities, fence agent CRUD, fence and SSH power
  actions, check for upgrade and upgrade, standalone Discover iSCSI, Configure
  Local Storage (`components/host-actions`, `components/host-form`).
- Data center: QoS CRUD for storage, CPU, network and host network; MAC pool
  selection; force remove; storage attach / detach from the Storage tab.
- In-tab actions: Manage Networks with role toggles on the cluster Networks
  tab, CPU profile CRUD on the cluster tab.

**Network**

- New / Edit Network: comment, STP, port isolation, label, QoS, DNS, external
  provider networks with subnet; import networks from a provider
  (`components/network-form`, `components/network-import`).
- Network detail: Clusters tab with attach / detach, vNIC Profiles tab with
  New / Edit / Remove, Labels tab with assign / remove.
- Setup Host Networks: bonds, IPv6, DNS, QoS override, NIC labels, SR-IOV, Sync
  All; Copy Host Networks.
- MAC pools page with CRUD (`pages/MacPoolsPage.tsx`).

**Administration**

- Users: add from directory, remove, detail page (General, Permissions, Quota,
  Groups, Event Subscriptions). Groups page.
- Roles with a permit tree editor, System Permissions, Scheduling Policies
  (filters, weights, balance, properties), Quotas with cluster and storage
  limit editors and a detail page, Providers with add / edit / remove / test
  connection and a detail page.

**Cross-cutting**

- Job steps drill-down, correlation-id filter and Clear finished on Tasks.
- Server-side bookmarks through `/bookmarks`.
- Documentation link; dashboard last-updated stamp, refresh control, inventory
  deep links and Gluster volumes row.

## 7. How this was counted

The original report carried a per-area scorecard (92 present, 48 partial, 108
missing, 14 deferred, about 50% covered). Those numbers came from per-area JSON
inventories that are not in the repository, so they cannot be recomputed and
the scorecard has been dropped rather than restated.

The only numbers kept are ones that can be reproduced from this file's history:
the 52 rows of the original section 3 ("Missing: core and common"), each
re-checked against the code on 2026-11-11.

| Area (original section 3) | Rows | Shipped | Partial | Open |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Storage | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| Compute: VMs / Templates / Pools / Affinity | 7 | 5 | 2 | 0 |
| Compute: Data Centers / Clusters / Hosts | 11 | 9 | 1 | 1 |
| Network | 8 | 8 | 0 | 0 |
| Administration / Configure | 12 | 10 | 0 | 2 |
| Cross-cutting | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| **Total** | **52** | **46** | **3** | **3** |

The partial rows are VM Import (no OVA, section 4), the standalone full-depth
New Template, and the Cockpit host console. The open rows are Guide Me for
data center and cluster, the Guide Me framework, and the Configure aggregate
dialog. A row counts as shipped when a wired UI surface and its resource
function were found in `app/src`; nothing here was exercised against a live
engine as part of this refresh. The gaps in section 2 that were never rows in
the original section 3 (for example roaming settings, TPM, the flat-list
context menus) are not part of this table.
